verdict.line: You lose the ranged poke war before level 6, but the 54-game sample still gives Jax the solo-kill edge once Leap Strike and Counter Strike are both off cooldown.

brief.thesis: Ornn wins the passive lane because Volcanic Rupture (Q, 800 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cd) slows and chips you for free while your own poke tools are all melee-range. The matchup swings back to even to slightly-favoured the moment you force an isolated all-in: Leap Strike (Q) closes the gap his Q bought him, and Counter Strike (E) negates the only basic-attack damage he has. The 42.6% head-to-head win rate over 54 games reflects a lane you survive passively and win actively, not a lane you're simply behind in.

tell.watch: Ornn's Brittle status icon on you

theirWindow.when: right after his W's final gout of flame hits you
theirWindow.what: That gout of flame from Bellows Breath (W) applies Brittle to you, and OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to use Counter Strike (E) to dodge his follow-up basic attack while you're Brittle — hold E through the flame rather than using it to initiate, or you eat a free trade.

yourWindow.when: his Volcanic Rupture (Q) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no slow or knockup available for up to 9 seconds at rank 1 (down to 7s at rank 5), walk him down and open with Leap Strike (Q) empowered by Empower (W) — he has nothing but Searing Charge (E, 450 range, 14-12s cd) to punish the engage, and that only knocks up if he hits terrain.

start.why: 38.9% win rate over 36 games and the majority pick (52.2%) — the extra sustained damage matters more than Doran's Helm's shield since your trades are short melee bursts, not extended poke absorption.

boots.why: 50% win rate over 34 games and the majority pick (53.1%) — Ornn's entire kit (Q, W, R) is magic damage, and the tenacity shortens how long his slows and Brittle windows pin you down.

core.why: The 33.3%-win-rate, 16.2%-pick core path starts here — the attack speed and burst proc feed directly into Empower (W) and Relentless Assault (R) stacking once you land a Counter Strike stun.
Second item on the same measured path — the on-hit proc rewards exactly the all-in trade pattern this matchup is built around.
Closes out the measured 3-item path and gives you a way to survive if Call of the Forge God (R) catches you out during a mid-game skirmish.

situational.when: he stacks pure health items and your flat damage trades start falling off
his elemental from Call of the Forge God (R) is adding chip damage you can't survive through on your all-in combo
you're already ahead and want to accelerate the snowball rather than itemize defensively

runes.keystoneWhy: The 38.1%-win-rate, 31.8%-pick page — the ramping attack speed stacks on top of Relentless Assault (R)'s own attack speed gain, so once Counter Strike (E) lands its stun you're attacking far faster than Ornn can trade back.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite runs a 48.4% win rate at 47% pick rate — Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills once Counter Strike (E) stuns him, and Flash lets you reposition out of a Searing Charge (E) wall-collision shockwave or a redirected Call of the Forge God (R) elemental.

playing.title: Don't trade into a live Volcanic Rupture
playing.detail: Walk up only when his Q (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cd) is visibly down — eating the fissure slow for free is how this lane gets lost before level 6.

playing.title: Hold Counter Strike for the Brittle auto
playing.detail: After Bellows Breath's final gout of flame applies Brittle, hold Counter Strike (E) rather than using it to engage — it dodges all incoming basic attacks, which is exactly what punishes you while Brittle.

playing.title: Open all-ins with Leap Strike, not autos
playing.detail: Leap Strike (Q, 17-5s cd scaling, 700 range) empowered by Empower (W) is your highest burst window — commit to the full combo once you're in range rather than poking with autos first.

playing.title: Stay off walls against his E
playing.detail: Searing Charge (E, 450 range) only knocks up if Ornn collides with terrain mid-charge — fighting in open lane removes his only hard engage tool.

playing.title: Track his ultimate cooldown after first cast
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God starts at 140s and drops to 100s by rank 3 — once he's burned it on a push or gank, that's your window to force a solo fight with no fear of the elemental.

playing.title: Use R to punish any extended trade
playing.detail: Relentless Assault's attack speed ramp and bonus-damage third hits turn a close fight decisively your way the moment he's forced to stand and swing back.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and all win rates above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why these numbers play out the way they do — is my own read on the kits, not measured data.
